element_title: Tree canopy and deep soil areas
title: Deep soil areas co-located with retained or adjoining trees, or sited to suit tree growth and communal open space
text: Deep soil areas are to be co-located with existing trees for retention and/or adjoining trees, or alternatively provided in a location that is conducive to tree growth and suitable for communal open space.
notes: Second sentence of A3.3.4; location quality is judgment.
